limitation: A recorded attestation establishes record completeness and current artifact bindings. It cannot prove that the reviewer opened an image, establish aesthetic superiority, or certify statistical validity or publication acceptance.
design_change_observation: Compared actual accepted baseline and candidate. The wider/shallower data rectangle and greater bar width reduce the tall hollow-column appearance, while more separated raw centers make all three observations easier to distinguish. Category order, original scales and numeric summary meaning remain. There is no clear hue preference independent of these geometry changes, and different adopted canvas sizes limit matched-size comparison.
